messages.指令を遂行しながら自分を強化し、代行 [ヘルメス]を溜めた後のFurioso-R: Fulfills Prescripts to strengthen himself and build Procuration [Hermes] for Furioso-Replica. A main fighter for longer battles that allow setup.
messages.序盤のバリアと保護、出血回数を増やす攻撃を両立する。生体材料を育てると、強化した: Combines early Shield and Protection with Bleed Count application. Building Corpus Ingredient lets her enhanced S3 attack multiple enemies.
messages.S3か守備で保存神域を張り、味方がスキルを使うときにバリアを配る。ル・ノワールの: S3 or defense creates a Sanctum of Conservation that grants Shield when allies use skills. Le Noir teammates accelerate her setup.
messages.コートとバリアで攻撃を引き受けながら保存を育て、強化形態に移ると破壊不能コインと: Takes attacks with her Overcoat and Shield while building Preservation, then attacks in her enhanced form with Unbreakable Coins and an improved S3. Fills both defensive and offensive roles.
messages.初めて守備を装着したターンの終了時に猛虎標弾へ切り替え、強化S3で火力をまとめる: Switches to Savage Tigermark Rounds at the end of the first turn he equips defense, enabling a powerful enhanced S3. His Clashes weaken on the turn after ammunition runs out.
messages.同じ敵・部位を攻撃し続けると点穴が溜まり、コイン再使用につながる。狙う相手を決め: Repeated attacks on the same enemy or part build Nerve Strike for Coin reuse. A main fighter suited to single bosses and consistent targeting.
messages.同じ敵とのマッチで決闘高潮を溜め、強化S3で振動爆発を重ねる。対象を絞れる集中戦: Clashes with the same enemy build The Duel Escalates for repeated Tremor Bursts with an enhanced S3. Suits Focused Encounters where he can maintain a target.
messages.試着室を経て新装になると、S2・S3のコイン再使用と回復で攻め続けられる。出血編: After the Changing Room leads to Full Makeover, S2/S3 Coin reuse and healing let her keep attacking. Bleed teams strengthen her further.
messages.予知眼がある間は条件付きで自動回避し、過熱へ移ると処分で大きく攻める。守りと攻め: Uses conditional automatic Evades with The Eye of Precognition, then unleashes Disposal during Overheat. An offensive and defensive main fighter for longer battles.
messages.条件付きで敵コインの有利な面が出る確率を下げ、自分の攻撃も強化する。挑発値と保護: Conditionally reduces enemy Coins' chance to roll their favorable face while strengthening her own attacks. Aggro and Protection help her take dangerous attacks.
messages.守備でランプを溜めて眩惑を付けると、S3の全コインが破壊不能になる。集中戦闘では: Builds Lamp with defense, then applies Dazzle to make all S3 Coins Unbreakable. Can draw attacks to himself in Focused Encounters, covering offense and defense against bosses.
messages.炎蝶の棺を溜めるほど攻撃が強くなり、棺30で強化S3や守備からの正午の解体を使え: Building Fire Butterfly Coffin strengthens attacks. At 30 Coffin, she can use enhanced S3 or Dismemberment at High Noon through defense. Combines damage and healing in long battles.
messages.同じスキルを続けて使い組札を合わせると光札が育ち、追撃の光斬につながる。毎ターン: Repeating the same skill to match her Hand builds Bright【光】 for the Kōzan [光斬] follow-up attack. Turn-by-turn skill selection determines her damage.
messages.精神力が高い加護では守備役、精神力を下げた絶望では減算コインの攻撃役を担う。守備: High-SP Blessing provides defense; low-SP Despair provides negative-Coin offense. Her defense skill lets her enter Despair deliberately.
